YouTubeGetBroadcaster.description: Gets the YouTube account you signed in with as the broadcaster: its name, handle, id and picture.
YouTubeGetBroadcaster.returns: The account (UserName, UserLogin, UserId, ProfileImageUrl, LastActive), or null when no broadcaster is signed in.
YouTubeGetBroadcaster.example:
var me = CPH.YouTubeGetBroadcaster();
if (me != null) CPH.LogInfo($"Broadcaster: {me.UserName}");

YouTubeGetBot.description: Gets the YouTube bot account you signed in with: its name, handle, id and picture.
YouTubeGetBot.returns: The account, or null when no bot account is signed in.
YouTubeGetBot.example:
var bot = CPH.YouTubeGetBot();
CPH.LogInfo(bot != null ? $"Bot: {bot.UserName}" : "No YouTube bot");

SendYouTubeMessageToLatestMonitored.description: Sends a message in the chat of your newest YouTube stream that Cuebot watches. Uses the bot account, or the broadcaster as fallback. Empty text sends nothing.

YouTubeSetTitle.description: Changes the title of your YouTube stream. Without a broadcast id it changes your newest watched stream.
YouTubeSetTitle.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the title was empty.
YouTubeSetTitle.example:
bool ok = CPH.YouTubeSetTitle("Speedrun practice!");
CPH.LogInfo($"Title changed: {ok}");

YouTubeSetDescription.description: Changes the description of your YouTube stream. Without a broadcast id it changes your newest watched stream.
YouTubeSetDescription.returns: true when it worked, otherwise false.

YouTubeSetCategory.description: Changes the category of your YouTube stream, by name like "Gaming" or "Music", or by YouTube's category number.
YouTubeSetCategory.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name is not a YouTube category.

YouTubeSetPrivacy.description: Changes who can see your YouTube stream: "public", "unlisted" or "private".
YouTubeSetPrivacy.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or nothing was given.

YouTubeSetMetaData.description: Changes title, description, privacy and category of your YouTube stream in one go. Leave a value empty (null) to keep it.
YouTubeSetMetaData.returns: true when every change worked, otherwise false.
YouTubeSetMetaData.example:
bool ok = CPH.YouTubeSetMetaData("Late night chill", null, "public", "Gaming");
CPH.LogInfo($"Updated: {ok}");

YouTubeAddTags.description: Adds tags to your YouTube stream. Tags it already has are not added twice.
YouTubeAddTags.returns: true when it worked, otherwise false.

YouTubeRemoveTags.description: Removes the listed tags from your YouTube stream.
YouTubeRemoveTags.returns: true when it worked, otherwise false.

YouTubeClearTags.description: Removes all tags from your YouTube stream.
YouTubeClearTags.returns: true when it worked, otherwise false.

YouTubeBanUserById.description: Bans someone from your YouTube chat by their channel id.
YouTubeBanUserById.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the id was empty.

YouTubeBanUserByName.description: Bans someone from your YouTube chat by name: a recent chatter's name or an @handle.
YouTubeBanUserByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

YouTubeTimeoutUserById.description: Times someone out in your YouTube chat for some seconds, by their channel id.
YouTubeTimeoutUserById.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the id was empty.

YouTubeTimeoutUserByName.description: Times someone out in your YouTube chat for some seconds, by name or @handle.
YouTubeTimeoutUserByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

KickBanUser.description: Bans someone from your Kick chat by name. You can add a reason. The bot setting is ignored.
KickBanUser.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

KickTimeoutUser.description: Times someone out in your Kick chat for some seconds. Kick counts in minutes, so it is rounded up. The bot setting is ignored.
KickTimeoutUser.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

KickUnbanUser.description: Lifts a ban or timeout on Kick, by name. The bot setting is ignored.
KickUnbanUser.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

KickDeleteChatMessage.description: Deletes one message in your Kick chat, by the message's id.
KickDeleteChatMessage.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the id was empty.

KickReplyToMessage.description: Replies to a message in your Kick chat. Uses the bot account, or the broadcaster as fallback.
KickReplyToMessage.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the text was empty.
KickReplyToMessage.example: if (CPH.TryGetArg("msgId", out string msgId)) CPH.KickReplyToMessage("Good question!", msgId);

KickSetTitle.description: Changes the title of your Kick stream.
KickSetTitle.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the title was empty.

KickSetCategory.description: Changes the category of your Kick stream, by name (or id).
KickSetCategory.returns: The category (only its name, and its id when you gave a number), or null when Kick refused.
KickSetCategory.example:
var category = CPH.KickSetCategory("Just Chatting");
CPH.LogInfo(category != null ? $"Now in {category.Name}" : "Kick refused");

SetKickUsersVarById.description: Sets a user variable to the same value for every Kick user id in the list. Persisted true keeps it after Cuebot restarts.

IncrementAllTwitchUsersVar.description: Adds a number to a user variable for every Twitch user who already has it. Persisted picks saved or temporary variables.

IncrementAllYouTubeUsersVar.description: Adds a number to a user variable for every YouTube user who already has it. Persisted picks saved or temporary variables.

IncrementAllKickUsersVar.description: Adds a number to a user variable for every Kick user who already has it. Persisted picks saved or temporary variables.

IncrementTwitchUsersVarById.description: Adds a number to a user variable for each listed Twitch user id. Users who do not have the variable yet are skipped.

IncrementYouTubeUsersVarById.description: Adds a number to a user variable for each listed YouTube user id. Users who do not have the variable yet are skipped.

IncrementAllKickUsersVarById.description: Adds a number to a user variable for each listed Kick user id. Users who do not have the variable yet are skipped.

IncrementOrCreateTwitchUsersVarById.description: Adds a number to a user variable for each listed Twitch user id. Users without it get it, starting from 0.

IncrementOrCreateYouTubeUsersVarById.description: Adds a number to a user variable for each listed YouTube user id. Users without it get it, starting from 0.

IncrementOrCreateKickUsersVarById.description: Adds a number to a user variable for each listed Kick user id. Users without it get it, starting from 0.

MeldStudioConnect.description: Starts connecting to Meld Studio. Cuebot keeps trying in the background. Cuebot has one Meld Studio connection, so use -1 or 0.
MeldStudioConnect.returns: true when connecting started, otherwise false.

MeldStudioDisconnect.description: Disconnects from Meld Studio. Use -1 or 0 for the connection; other numbers only write a warning.

MeldStudioIsConnected.description: Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Meld Studio right now.

MeldStudioGetConnectionByName.description: Gives the number of a Meld Studio connection. Cuebot has only one, so any name gives 0.
MeldStudioGetConnectionByName.returns: 0 when Cuebot's Meld Studio part is loaded, otherwise -1.

MeldStudioShowScene.description: Switches Meld Studio to a scene, by its Meld id. A scene name works too.
MeldStudioShowScene.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or nothing was given.

MeldStudioShowSceneByName.description: Switches Meld Studio to a scene by its name, like "Gameplay".
MeldStudioShowSceneByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the name was empty.

MeldStudioShowLayerByName.description: Shows a layer in Meld Studio, by the scene name and the layer name.
MeldStudioShowLayerByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the layer name was empty.

MeldStudioHideLayerByName.description: Hides a layer in Meld Studio, by the scene name and the layer name.
MeldStudioHideLayerByName.returns: true when it worked, false when it failed or the layer name was empty.

ObsCreateRecordChapter.description: Adds a chapter mark to your OBS recording, like "Boss fight". Needs OBS 30.2 or newer, recording as Hybrid MP4.
ObsCreateRecordChapter.returns: true when it worked, otherwise false.

ObsIsFilterEnabled.description: Checks whether a filter is turned on in OBS. Give a scene and filter name, or a scene, source and filter name for a source's filter.
ObsIsFilterEnabled.returns: true when the filter is on, otherwise false.

ObsSetFilterState.description: Sets an OBS filter: 0 turns it on, 1 turns it off, 2 flips it. Give a scene's filter, or a scene, source and filter for a source's filter.

ObsToggleFilter.description: Flips an OBS filter on or off. Give a scene's filter, or a scene, source and filter for a source's filter.

ObsSetRandomFilterState.description: Picks one random filter of a scene (or of a source) and sets it: 0 on, 1 off, 2 flip. Nothing happens when there are no filters.

ObsHideSourcesFilters.description: Turns off every filter of an OBS source. The source is found by its name; the scene is not used.

ObsHideScenesFilters.description: Turns off every filter of an OBS scene.

Parse.description: Fills in the variables in a text: %arguments%, ~global variables~ and inline functions. Give your own values to use instead of this run's arguments.
Parse.returns: The text with every variable filled in.
Parse.example:
string text = CPH.Parse("Thanks for the raid, %user%!");
CPH.SendMessage(text);
